This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin. They also could have dark blue markings on their faces.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|7}}</ref> a member of this species was present in a [[Sorgan Common House|common house]] on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]], where they cheered on [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]] and an [[Zabrak|Iridonian]] [[Unidentified Zabrak fighter|Zabrak]], who were grappling while connected via [[Laser Tether]].<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 7: The Reckoning|seventh episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Chapter 7" />
